Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value `true`, ONLY when this answer is the stored replay of an earlier request that used the same `Idempotency-Key` (the handler did not run again). The first execution never carries it.

204.description: The case was broken and the task completed. No response body.

400.description: The `Idempotency-Key` header is missing (`idempotency-key-required`) or not 1-128 printable ASCII characters (`idempotency-key-invalid`) on a POST, or the request body is malformed JSON, a required field is missing or empty, or a field value is invalid (e.g. a task type outside the TaskType enum).
